Name: Requiring bike share operator verification of rider age.
Title: A Local Law to amend the administrative code of the city of New York, in relation to requiring bike share operator verification of rider age

History.Description: This Introduction was Introduced by Council
This Introduction was Referred to Comm by Council to the Committee on Transportation and Infrastructure

Summary: This bill would require that any bike share operator, like Citi Bike, running a bike share program in New York City verify the age of anyone seeking to rent a bicycle, whether traditional or e-bike, with a government- or educational institution-issued identification card. The Department of Transportation (DOT) could promulgate rules that allow for other methods of age verification, but it must assess any privacy concerns with these methods. If the age verification requirement cannot be applied consistently with the existing contract between the City and Citi Bike, this bill would apply to a contract entered into or renewed after the bill’s effective date.
Text:
A Local Law to amend the administrative code of the city of New York, in relation to requiring bike share operator verification of rider age

Be it enacted by the Council as follows:


Section 1. Subchapter 3 of chapter 1 of title 19 of the administrative code of the city of New York is amended by adding new section 19-192 to read as follows:
§ 19-192 Bike share age verification. a. Definitions. As used in this section, the following terms have the following meanings:
Bicycle. The term “bicycle” has the same meaning as set forth in paragraph (1) of subdivision a of section 19-176.
Bicycle with electric assist. The term “bicycle with electric assist” has the same meaning as set forth in section 102-c of the vehicle and traffic law.
Bike share device. The term “bike share device” means any bicycle or bicycle with electric assist that the bike share operator makes available as part of the bike share program.
Bike share operator. The term “bike share operator” means the company operating the bike share program.
Bike share program. The term “bike share program” means the provision of public bike share devices for shared use within the city under a contract between the bike share operator and the department that permits payment for the use of such bike share devices.
b. 1. The commissioner shall require that, under the contract agreement between the city and the bike share operator regarding the bike share program, the bike share operator shall verify through a driver’s license or other photographic identification card issued by a government entity or educational institution that an individual using a bike share device is at least 16 years of age.
2. The commissioner may promulgate rules concerning other methods or technologies that the bike share operator may use to verify the age of an individual using a bike share device, provided that the commissioner consider any privacy concerns at issue with such methods or technologies.
§ 2. This local law takes effect 120 days after it becomes law, provided that where the provisions of section 19-192 of the administrative code of the city of New York, as added by section one of this local law, cannot be applied consistently with currently applicable contracts, such provisions only apply with respect to contracts entered into or renewed after the effective date of this local law.
